text:
liz: quick ping — discovered two parity issues while running the Go sample app for customer onboarding: (1) SDK lacks the /v1/projects/{id}/keys:rotate REST operation binding (we can rotate API keys via curl but not via SDK), (2) SDK retries on 401 with infinite loop.

omar: thanks. can you paste the curl that worked and the Go code that fails?

liz: curl that works:
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/projects/p_abc123/keys:rotate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{}'\n```

liz: Go code (using github.com/redwood/go-sdk v0.4.0):
```go
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
resp, err := client.Projects.RotateKey(ctx, "p_abc123")
if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
fmt.Println(resp.Key)
```

liz: errors at runtime: "RotateKey not found". Meanwhile when I intentionally use an expired token the SDK keeps retrying for >30s and eventually times out; REST returns 401 immediately.

pat: oof. first one is a missing binding, probably generator skipped methods with ":" in path or new operationId. second one sounds like our http client has a retry middleware that treats 401 same as 5xx.

omar: I dug into openapi: the path exists and has operationId rotateProjectKey, and it has x-admin: true. generator has a safety rule dropping x-admin unless flagged in config. we updated the server to unlock rotate via admin scope but forgot to flip generator config.

pat: for retries: middleware config defaulted to retry on network error and status >= 400. Gross. Should only retry for idempotent operations and for 429/5xx — not 401/403. Also add maxAttempts and exponential backoff jitter.

liz: workaround for onboarding: call REST from Go using net/http, but customer expects SDK sample to work. I added a tiny helper in sample-app: https://github.com/redwood/sample-go-onboard/commit/6f7a1e to use REST rotate.

ci-bot: failing test redwood-go/tests/integration/rotate_key_test.go on main.

omar: plan: (A) flip generator flag to include x-admin paths that have x-public: true fallback, (B) add RotateKey binding in next SDK gen, (C) change retry policy: do not retry on 401/403, only retry on 429 and 5xx with exponential backoff up to 4 attempts. Also add logging for retry decisions.

pat: I'll own (C) and add unit tests to assert no retry on 401. Also add integration that simulates expired token and ensures SDK surfaces 401 quickly.

omar: I'll own (A)/(B), regenerate Go SDK, add binding, and bump to v0.4.1. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/redwood-go-sdk/pull/27.

liz: can we get a patch release by EOD? onboarding window is tomorrow morning.

omar: we'll try to push v0.4.1-rc today. if we can't, the sample-app helper using direct REST is the short-term mitigation and I've updated README with explicit admin scope instructions.

pat: QA notes: add e2e test that calls rotateKey with a valid admin key and asserts no retry loop; add negative test with expired key that asserts immediate 401 and no retry attempts.

ci-bot: created issue RNF-2480 for generator config and RNF-2481 for retry policy.

liz: confirmed helper REST path works for me locally and customer; will notify onboarding team. leaving logs and repro in sample app issue: https://github.com/redwood/sample-go-onboard/issues/9

omar: fixed generator config on staging, regenerated bindings, and opened PR. awaiting review.

devx-bot: release note draft: "Fix: Go SDK: add projects.keys:rotate binding and prevent SDK retry on 401/403; improved retry/backoff behavior." scheduled for v0.4.1.

pat: merged retry policy PR, tests added.

liz: confirmed v0.4.1-rc rotates keys and returns 401 immediately when token expired. onboarding moved forward.

devx-bot: thread archived.
